business_summary: Chongqing Jiheng Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. develops, produces and sells building materials and chemicals in China and internationally. It operates through two segments, Buildings Materials Chemical Industry; and Pharmaceutical Manufacturing. The company offers commercial concrete, water reducing agents, and expansion agents for industrial and civil buildings, highways, railways, bridges, tunnels, airports, water conservancy, and hydropower; and sulfuric acid is mainly used in the production of fertilizers and in non-fertilizer acid enterprises such as fertilizers, chemicals, light industry, textile, steel, water reducer, and other non-fertilizer acid enterprises; and concrete admixtures. It also provides pharmaceutical intermediates, such as procaine hydrochloride, cefoxitin acid intermediates, chlorine intermediates, chloramphenicol intermediates, aztreonam intermediates, and orlistat intermediates used in antibiotic drugs, anti-hepatitis C drugs, diabetes drugs, benzathine penicillin and cefoxitin, procaine penicillin, and cosmetics; and API products, including acetaminophen, cloperidine hydrochloride, levofloxacin mesylate, benolate, and diphenhydramine hydrochloride. In addition, the company offers preparation products comprising compound acetaminophen and diphenhydramine tablets, clopidogrel hydrochloride tablets, clarithromycin sustained-release tablets, diclofenac sodium enteric-coated tablets, acetaminophen tablets, and famotidine tablets used in antipyretic and analgesic, antiviral, antibacterial, cough, allergy, local anesthesia; and famotidine, diclofenac sodium, nifedipine, acetaminophen, furosemide, norfloxacin used in clinical drugs to meet basic drug needs. The company was formerly known as Chongqing Sansheng Industrial Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Chongqing Jiheng Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. in June 2026. Chongqing Jiheng Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Chongqing, China.
business_summary_ko: Chongqing Jiheng Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.는 중국 및 국제적으로 건축 자재 및 화학 물질을 개발, 생산 및 판매합니다. 그것은 건축 자재 화학 산업이라는 두 가지 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 및 제약 제조. 이 회사는 산업 및 민간 건물, 고속도로, 철도, 교량, 터널, 공항, 수자원 보호 및 수력 발전을 위한 상업용 콘크리트, 감수제 및 팽창제를 제공합니다. 황산은 주로 비료 생산과 비료, 화학, 경공업, 방직, 철강, 감수제 및 기타 비비료 산성 기업 등 비비료 산성 기업에 사용된다. 및 콘크리트 혼화제. 또한 항생제, C형 간염 치료제, 당뇨병 치료제, 벤자틴 페니실린 및 세폭시틴, 프로카인 페니실린 및 화장품에 사용되는 프로카인염산염, 세폭시틴산 중간체, 염소 중간체, 클로람페니콜 중간체, 아즈트레오남 중간체, 오를리스타트 중간체 등 의약품 중간체를 제공합니다. 아세트아미노펜, 클로페리딘 염산염, 레보플록사신 메실레이트, 베놀레이트, 디펜히드라민 염산염을 포함한 API 제품. 게다가
